messages:
kevin: FYI — noticed we lost audit events for /secret/data/partner/* after an RBAC change. This looks related to infra-pr/432 (tf) which removed the binding that ensured audit logging for that path. Creating coordination thread.
maria: when did this start? any exposed creds?
kevin: gap from 2026-03-21T03:12:00Z -> 2026-03-21T07:45:00Z per alert. security-bot flagged missing entries for that path.
alice: that was my tf change — I removed the 'audit_log_writer' grant for legacy-role because it overlapped a wildcard. didn't intend to drop the partner path. sorry.
sam: ok, priority = P1. We need rotation + rewrap + audit backfill. Also need to confirm if any external partner keys were used during the window.
nelly (oncall): I'm on pager. I'll hold the page for partner ops DM if needed.
security-bot: alert details: missing_audit_entries: /secret/data/partner/*; start: 2026-03-21T03:12:06Z; end: 2026-03-21T07:45:30Z; candidate_failures: vault-audit-azureblob streamer failed for some object ids.
kevin: immediate plan:
- revert tf change (alice) — revert PR or apply patch to re-add binding. ETA 30m.
- rotate partner CI tokens & service keys (maria) — issue new creds + revoke old tokens and leases. ETA 2h.
- rewrap KMS ciphertexts that may reference old keys (sam) — run kms rewrap job + verify digests. ETA 3h.
- run audit backfill (nelly) — rehydrate logs from audit-stream archive and inject to SIEM. ETA 4h.
maria: for rotation I'll:
1) create new service-account in project partner-prod
2) generate key via partner-ci (GCP) and push to Vault at secret/partner/ci-token/new
3) update partner webhook creds, ping partner ops
sam: commands I'm going to run (short):
```bash
# revoke all active tokens for partner role (use with care)
vault list auth/token/accessors | xargs -n1 vault token revoke -accessor
# force leases to expire for path
vault lease revoke -prefix secret/partner
# rewrap ciphertexts using KMS key "projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/rewrap-key"
gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring rw --key rewrap-key --plaintext-file - 
```
alice: I'm reverting the tf now. PR #432 -> revert in progress. will ping when applied.
kevin: partner ops alerted; partner SRE is standby. also creating ticket RW-SEC-7891 for audit/backfill + postmortem.
maria: I'll coordinate the partner-facing changelog + stage the new token in the pipeline. DMing @partner_ops now.
nelly (oncall): started audit backfill job: job id abf-20260321-01. monitoring output. ETA ~3.5h to finish.
security-bot: postmortem template saved to https://redwood.internal/pm/RW-SEC-7891
sam: after rotation we'll run regression checks: small eval to ensure tokens are valid and app auth flows unchanged.
kevin: thanks all. update here when each step is done. :thumbsup:
alice: revert applied, infra apply succeeded at 2026-03-21T08:05:12Z
maria: new partner tokens issued and staged, partner confirmed cutover at 2026-03-21T09:22Z
sam: rewrap job completed, verified ciphertext digests match expected, logs: rewrap_ok: 284 items
nelly (oncall): audit backfill complete; SIEM ingestion shows events from gap window. closing immediate incident; creating follow-ups in RW-SEC-7891.
kevin: great work. follow-ups: add automated policy test to prevent removing audit write grants, add alert rule for audit fill-rate drop. assigning to @eng-qa and @infra-team.
maria: noted — I'll open infra tickets. closing loop here.
